question: If x + (1)/(x) = 3, then find the value of x³ + (1)/(x³).
solution:
**Given:**

If x + 1/x = 3

**Formula used:**

(x + 1/x)³ = x³ + 1/x³ + 3x(1/x)(x + 1/x)

**Calculations:**

(x + 1/x)³ = 3³

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = x³ + 1/x³ + 3(x + 1/x)

⇒ 27 = x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × 3

⇒ 27 = x³ + 1/x³ + 9

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 27 - 9

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 18

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let x + 1/x = P

Then, x3 + (1)/(x³) = P³ - 3P

x + 1/x = P = 3

x3 + (1)/(x³) = 3³ - 3 × 3 = 27 - 9 = **18**
